utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, when’s the repair drive actually starting? I’ve got a broken fence post that’s been waiting weeks.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I think they're starting this Saturday morning. I saw a flyer at the grocery store about it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: This Saturday? Alright, what time should I show up to grab some tools?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Noah, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need me to bring over my toolbox?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive! That would be great, thanks Gus.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem at all, just let me know what day works best and I'll roll my cart over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Pia, have you heard about the repair drive they're organizing at the community center? I heard it's going to be this weekend!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, I did hear something about that. Do they have enough tools and parts for everyone who shows up?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, I heard Jerry from the hardware store is donating a bunch of screwdrivers and wrenches, but I'm not sure about parts—that's the part people are worried about.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Opal, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need any help with that?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, actually! I'm mapping out where everyone lives so we can coordinate pickup spots. Could you tell me your address again?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, it's 123 Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? I think it'd be a great chance to fix things up around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I heard about it. I might stop by if I can get away for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome! I'm rallying everyone to bring their broken stuff. Want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo! I'm glad you're here to talk about the repair drive. How can I help you get involved?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for stepping up! We could really use a hand with fixing a few broken fence panels and a leaky hose—do you have any tools or experience with those?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Dane, about that repair drive—are we talking about the one for the community center's water pump or something else?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that's the one—the water pump's been acting up again, right? I heard it's been giving folks trouble.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Right, it's been sputtering on and off for a few days. Do you know exactly what part needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Mara, I was thinking we could use the school's parking lot for the repair drive—it's central and most families know where it is.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, that's a great idea! The school lot is easy to access and has plenty of space for everyone to bring their broken items.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I'll check with the principal about getting permission for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Jules, I heard you're organizing a repair drive—anything I can do to help?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh hey Nell, yes! I'm trying to gather folks who can fix bikes and small appliances for the neighborhood. Do you have any skills like that?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not much of a fixer, but I know a few people who might be handy—want me to ask around?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Kira, what's this about a repair drive? I only have a minute.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? Are you sure you heard that right? I thought it was just a regular community clean-up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, maybe I mixed it up. Either way, I'm in if it's quick—just tell me when and where.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard there's a repair drive happening. Do you need any help with that?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, a repair drive? I think I heard something about that... but I can't quite recall. Maybe I should check my notes?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No worries, I can fill you in. They're collecting old electronics at the community center this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Cleo, did you hear we're organizing a repair drive this Saturday? I was thinking of bringing my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, a repair drive! I think I have some spare parts in my garage. Want me to check what I have that might be useful?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That sounds great, Cleo! I'm bringing my old toaster, so if you find any small appliance parts, that'd be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Rey, I heard you're organizing a repair drive for the neighborhood. Need a hand passing out flyers or something while I'm out shopping?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, hey Ira, yeah that would be great actually. I’ve got a stack of flyers ready if you wouldn’t mind taking a few.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing, just point me to the stack and I'll grab some on my way to the store.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Vik! I was just thinking about that repair drive—did we already decide on a date for it?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Didn't we say the 15th? I'm pretty sure that's what we decided.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: The 15th? Right, right—I knew that. I've got it somewhere... on a paper or in my head. Anyway, I'll be there!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Leo. What's this about a repair drive again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s this Saturday, 9 a.m. at the community center. Bring tools if you have any.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday morning? I think I've got a wrench somewhere in the garage... probably.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Eli, I heard about the repair drive—I've got a toolbox full of stuff we could use if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well now, Gus, that's mighty thoughtful of you. Let me get my list of what's needed before we start rooting through your toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli. Take your time—I'll be right here when you're ready to go through it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Quinn! Are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Mara! Everyone's chipping in, and I've already rallied a bunch of folks to bring tools and snacks.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I'll bring my toolbox and some lemonade. See you Saturday morning!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal, I heard about the repair drive — count me in to help organize!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great! Let's start by mapping out all the houses that need repairs; I've got a list going already.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, I can help you sort through that list and maybe rope in some of my other friends to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo! I was hoping to chat with you about the upcoming neighborhood repair drive. Are you free to help out?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely, Rosa! I've been keeping tabs on what supplies we have. Let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, Cleo! Could you give me a quick rundown of what we've got so far? I'd like to see if we need to put out a call for any missing items.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Mina, I heard there's a repair drive happening—what's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's just a neighborhood thing to help folks fix up their homes and yards. You planning to volunteer or need something done?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds great! I'm still getting settled, so I might just need a little help with some yard work. What kind of things are people fixing up?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey, what's the repair drive about? Give me the short version.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's a community event where everyone brings broken household items to the school parking lot, and volunteers help fix them for free.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, I might drop by with my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Kira, I heard you're organizing a repair drive for the neighborhood. How can I lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you actually want to help? I'm just checking, because people talk a lot around here but rarely follow through.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Kira. I’ve got a sturdy toolbox and plenty of Saturday mornings free — just tell me where to show up.
